Gzipped HTML from the documented MediaWiki parse API (en.wikipedia.org), used only as parser test fixtures.
Source: Wikipedia contributors, "2025 Masters Tournament", "2003 PGA Championship", "2026 LPGA Tour". Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

`locale-home-index.json`: a trimmed copy of the published Golf projection index (dist/index-snapshot.json, as of 2026-10-05) used by tests/locale-proof.test.mjs to render the home and All Access pages for catalog coverage. Public projection fields only; names and places are published data.
